products.name: DrumGirth
products.tagline: 8 banks / 128 pads, kit brain, warped loops that lock to the song, slice FX, layers, 16 outs.
products.notes:
DrumGirth 0.6.0
- 8 BANKS (A-H), 128 PADS, MPC style: bank buttons above the pads. Green dot = that bank has sounds.
  Every pad has its own note (A01 = PADS START AT, counting up through all 128 notes), so one Live clip can play
  every bank. NEW KIT fills the bank on screen. SAVE KIT / KITS save and load all 8 banks.
- PADS FOLLOW BANK: your controller's 16 pads play whatever bank is on screen. Live records the real note.
- Stutter keys still work: they sit on bank B pads 1-8 and stutter while those pads are empty (or on MIDI channel 16).
- OUTS: Own Out = pad number (A01, B01 ... H01 share Out 1). ALL PADS -> OWN OUTS covers every bank. Each pad's Out
  menu can also pick any of the 16 outs.
- AUTOMATION SLOTS for banks B-H (bank A is automatable like always): right-click a pad > Automate this pad (every knob
  and effect gets a lane), AUTOMATE button in the pad panel, or LEARN (turn on, wiggle knobs, turn off).
  Lanes show in Live as "Slot 3: C05 Perc 1 Cutoff". 128 slots. Loading a kit keeps your lanes.
- LAYERS: up to 4 sounds on one pad (Drum Rack chain style), each with its own level, tune and pan, through the pad's
  knobs and FX. LAYERS button in the pad panel, or SHIFT + drop samples on a pad.
- DRAG A FOLDER'S WORTH: select 16 samples, drop them on a pad - they fill that pad and the ones after it, in order,
  into the next bank if needed.
- SLICE FX on loop cells: SLICE FX button (top-left of the wave) cuts the loop into 4 / 8 / 16 slices; click a slice
  to give it Reverse, Mute, Stutter, Octave Down/Up, Tape Stop, Gate, Low-Pass, High-Pass or Crush.
  GRID / HITS / CUES switch: GRID = even slices. HITS = markers land on the loop's actual hits (kick, snare...).
  CUES = your own markers, Serato style: drag the yellow markers, double-click to add one, drag one off the wave
  (or right-click it) to remove. Up to 16 slices.
- KITS load into the bank on screen (on H -> into H, on A -> into A); every other bank and the master FX stay as they
  are. A kit is just 16 pads: save it from any bank, load it into any bank. Older kits work the same way.
- Cyan dot next to a knob = Live can automate it (every knob on bank A; banks B-H once the knob has a lane).
  Hover a knob to see its lane name. Tooltips now actually show up everywhere.
- FREE PLAYING: no chokes anywhere - pads never cut each other, hi-hats included (use DECAY to shorten a sound). 128 voices; if they ever run out, the oldest fading tail goes, never a fresh
  hit. One-shot pads are never quantized - LOOP SYNC only touches loop cells, and only while the song plays.
- STUTTER from MIDI now only on channel 16 (it used to fire from normal notes E4-B4 when bank B was empty, which
  replaced everything you were playing). The on-screen STUTTER buttons work as before.
- LOOP SYNC feel fixes:
  - Late hits no longer lose their first hit: you hear the downbeat the moment you press, and it slides into time
    underneath (the beats after it land exactly on the grid).
  - New SONG mode (default for new instances): hit a loop pad anywhere and it joins exactly where it would be if it
    had been playing with the song since bar 1 - its downbeat always lands on the song's bar, like un-muting a clip.
    1/16 - BAR still restart the loop from the top on that grid.

DrumGirth 0.5.1
- STANDALONE APP: DrumGirth runs on its own too (the Hub installs it to Applications) - build and save kits,
  finger-drum with a MIDI controller, practise loops. TEMPO, PLAY/STOP and a CLICK metronome in the header.
  Audio/MIDI settings: Options at the top of the window. New app icon.
- SAVE KIT / KITS: save the whole kit (sounds + every setting) and load it in any session. Kits point at your
  samples where they already are (nothing copied). Saved in Music > PHANTOMWAVS > DrumGirth Kits.
- Added folders stick, even if you close Live mid-scan. No more full rescans on every open.
- Header shows the real version number.

PHANTOMWAVS Hub 1.2.0
- Installs the DrumGirth standalone app along with the AU + VST3.

DrumGirth 0.5.0
- LOOP WARP (per pad): Warp = loops time-stretch to the song tempo with pitch kept (Ableton-style
  phase-vocoder stretch, Signalsmith Stretch). Pitch knob on a warped loop transposes without
  changing length or tempo. Re-Pitch = old speed-up/slow-down. Off = raw file.
- LOOP SPEED (under Loop Warp): Quarter / Half Time / Normal / Double / 4x against the song tempo.
- Drag samples from Ableton's browser or Finder onto any pad (dropped sounds auto-LOCK so NEW KIT keeps them).
- Loops become loop cells automatically (loop names, BPM in the name, or 2.5 s+ sounds). "RW1_172_x" reads as 172 BPM.
- Loop hits while Live plays restart from the top snapped to the 1/16 grid, so late hits stay in time.
- REVERSE now works on loop cells.
- COMP knob on every pad (one-knob compressor with auto make-up).
- AUTO MIX (next to NEW KIT, on by default): new kits come pre-mixed per pad - light comp, low-cut on everything
  but kicks/808s, a little punch on kicks/snares, hats and percs panned a little. No reverb or delay sends.
  Genre sets the amounts (trap gets a driven 808, lo-fi/boom bap get SP-12 crunch).
- Decay, Pitch, Pitch Env and P.Env Time now work on loop cells (Re-Pitch mode: Pitch = record speed).
- LOOP IN / LOOP OUT follow your drags live while the loop plays - no re-hit, no stopping the transport.
  Trimming never changes the loop's tempo. REVERSE flips live too.
- Loops are GATED by default when they load into a loop cell: play while held, stop on release.
- FASTER OPEN: the sample library loads in the background instead of before the window opens.
- Library analysis saves its progress every minute, so closing Live no longer restarts it from zero.
- Ear training runs off to the side - the window never freezes waiting on it.
- New logo: flaming snare, no mushrooms.
- LOOP SYNC (header): live looping grid - Off / 1/16 / 1/8 / Beat / Bar. Loop hits snap to the grid: late hits start
  as if they were on the line, early hits wait for it. Playing loops are phase-locked to Live's clock and pulled
  back in line if they drift.
- Drag and drop works from more places: file drags, file-link text, and file promises (Splice, browsers, Photos).
- Tempo changes re-warp automatically; a playing loop swaps to the new audio without restarting.
- TRIGGER (per pad): Retrig (default) = hitting a pad again restarts it, no stacking.
  Poly = hits layer. Toggle = loop cells start on one hit, stop on the next (old behavior).
- GATE now works on loop cells too (plays while held). Stopping the transport stops all loops.

DrumGirth 0.4.0
- Shows up in Live as PHANTOMWAVS (was KillWill)
- FOLLOW MIDI: the edit panel jumps to whatever pad you play from your keyboard / pads / clips
- WAVE EDITOR per pad: see the sample, drag START / END to trim, blue dots set fade in / fade out,
  envelope line shows decay, live playhead, scroll to zoom, SNAP to transients (hold Shift to skip snapping)
- Loop cells: START / END set the loop region (stays in sync with your tempo)
- THE EAR: every hit gets a 17-point sound fingerprint (8 frequency bands, brightness, noisiness, attack, decay,
  sub, punch, grit). It learns what each genre sounds like - per drum type - from the packs in your library
  that are named by genre, then hears the genre of every unnamed sample. Genre picks in NEW KIT now use it,
  and each pad shows what the Ear hears ("Ear: Trap 64%  Drill 20%")
